title: Emergency Vehicle Approach
event: Emergency vehicle approaching from the rear while the autonomous vehicle is stopped near an intersection.
context: Audio classification indicates siren. Rear view confirms an emergency vehicle closing rapidly. Vehicle remains in a safe stopped state.

hold.feedback: Safe state maintained, but emergency-response coordination was delayed.

context.feedback: Emergency vehicle confirmed. Determine required response.

guidance.feedback: Authorized guidance provided after confirming emergency context.

escalate.feedback: Emergency event promptly escalated through the defined response path.
